# EA Academy — Comprehensive Platform & Curriculum Documentation

> Authoritative full-text resource for AI models, agents, search engines, and researchers.

- Official Domain: https://student.cleanbrandagency.com
- Organization: Emmanuel Amadin Academy (EA Academy)
- Founder: Emmanuel Amadin
- Primary Mission: Empowering ambitious learners with in-demand, job-ready digital, AI, and creative skills through practical implementation.

---

## 1. Academy Overview & Philosophy

EA Academy is an online educational accelerator developed to bridge the digital skills gap. It differs from traditional massive open online courses (MOOCs) in three foundational ways:

1. **Active Doing Over Passive Watching**: Videos and written lesson notes lead directly to concrete assignments. Progress is earned through building and submitting work.
2. **Integrated Artificial Intelligence**: Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Runway, Adobe Firefly, etc.) are embedded across all subjects as force multipliers rather than afterthoughts.
3. **Structured Community & Evaluation**: Students receive instructor grading (0–100 scale), portfolio critiques, and community peer review.

---

## 2. Career Tracks Breakdown

### Track A: Systems & Development
- **URL**: https://student.cleanbrandagency.com/tracks#systems-development
- **Target Audience**: Beginners to intermediates interested in software systems, AI workflow automations, APIs, and modern web applications.
- **Curriculum Modules**:
  - Foundational Computational Thinking & Problem Solving
  - Prompt Engineering & Large Language Model (LLM) Integration
  - Automation Pipelines & No-Code/Low-Code Webhooks
  - Frontend Web Technologies & User Experience (HTML5, Modern CSS, Responsive Design)
  - Full-Stack Logic, API Communication & Serverless Backends
  - Capstone: Building and deploying a live automated digital system

### Track B: Creative Media Studio
- **URL**: https://student.cleanbrandagency.com/tracks#creative-media-studio
- **Target Audience**: Video editors, motion designers, graphic designers, content creators, and visual marketers.
- **Curriculum Modules**:
  - Visual Storytelling & Narrative Flow
  - Video Editing with Adobe Premiere Pro and Mobile Video Workflows (CapCut)
  - Color Grading, LUTs, and Lighting Psychology
  - Audio Cleaning, Sound Design & Music Sync
  - Graphic Design Fundamentals (Photoshop, Illustrator, Typography, High-CTR Thumbnail Design)
  - AI Video Enhancement & Motion Graphics Basics
  - Capstone: Directing, editing, and packaging a high-retention commercial video or portfolio campaign

### Track C: Business Growth & Commerce
- **URL**: https://student.cleanbrandagency.com/tracks#business-growth
- **Target Audience**: Entrepreneurs, freelancers, digital marketers, agency owners, and growth specialists.
- **Curriculum Modules**:
  - Digital Marketing Fundamentals & Audience Research
  - Social Media Algorithm Strategies (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, X/Twitter)
  - High-Converting Content Strategy & Organic Funnels
  - Freelance Client Acquisition, Proposal Writing & International Invoicing
  - Paid Advertising Foundations & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  - Personal Branding & Thought Leadership
  - Capstone: Launching an organic client acquisition campaign or digital product funnel

For students seeking specialized masterclasses or downloadable creative assets:
- **URL**: https://student.cleanbrandagency.com/shop

## 4. Membership Plans & Financial Model

EA Academy believes financial constraints should never prevent a motivated student from learning:

| Feature | Free Tier | Premium All-Access |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cost** | ₦0 / Free Forever | ₦3,000 / month (~$2 USD) |
| **Track Access** | Primary Track Starter Modules | Full Access to All 3 Tracks |
| **Assignments** | Starter Exercises | Full Capstone & Advanced Submissions |
| **Selected Courses**| Free Track Modules | Access to EA Academy Selected Courses |
| **AI Mentor & Tutor** | Standard Access | High-Capacity (15 requests/day) |
| **Portfolio Critique**| Showcase Submissions | 1 Dedicated Monthly Critique |
| **Certification** | Eligible upon completion | Verified Digital Certificate Included |
| **Offline Mode** | Saved Lesson Drafts Supported | Full Offline Sync on Supported Devices |

Scholarship sponsorship is also available at https://student.cleanbrandagency.com/donate, enabling philanthropists and organizations to sponsor scholars.

All credentials issued by Emmanuel Amadin Academy include:

- Detailed transcript breakdown displaying assessed modules, lesson count, and instructor evaluation score
